heading: Availability of land and water conservation fund moneys
lead: Funds hereafter appropriated and available for the acquisition of lands and waters and interests therein in the national forest system pursuant to section 200306 of title 54 shall be available for the acquisition of any lands, waters, and interests therein within the boundaries of the recreation area.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–287 substituted “section 200306 of title 54” for “section 460l–9 of this title,”.
